author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Answers viewers' yes-or-no questions from Twitch and Kick channel point rewards or an optional chat command, in the chat the question came from, with an optional overlay card.
changelog: 4.0.59: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.0.59, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.54: new Magic 8-Ball extension for channel point rewards and an optional command.

manifest.name: Magic 8-Ball
installationSteps: Create a channel point reward on Twitch and/or Kick (for example "Magic 8-Ball"), turn on "Require viewer to enter text" so viewers can type a question, and paste each reward ID into its Twitch or Kick box.
Optional: set a chat command such as ask. If you use !8ball, turn off the 8-Ball command in Village Fun Commands first so chat does not get two answers.
Optional: add the overlay as a browser source (1920x1080) to show each question and answer on stream.
Enable the extension and restart StreamBridge.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension and remove its browser source if you added one.

healthChecks.description: Confirms reward and command matching, cooldowns, and source-platform-only replies.
